name: BlueVPN
description: Make maintenance, forced update, automatic update and announcements from the admin panel effective in the Android app; automatically download the ABI-specific APK and launch Android's installer; make connection attempts cancellable and disconnect the Xray service immediately with race-safe retries; remove the one-minute account/subscription ticker; synchronize only on a fresh app activity launch; and eliminate navigation-triggered network work to reduce section switching lag.
